text:
anita: quick idea 1: introduce a tiny, mandatory 'assertion-lite' header set at edge proxies to make cost attribution and basic SLO signals reliable across late-enrichment flows. goal: minimal instrumentation surface so adoption is easy.

mike: curious what you want in the minimal set. size matters here (esp for mobile/edge flows).

anita: minimal attributes we can put in headers (one-liners): trace_id, service, route, billing_key (if known), assertion_source, latency_ms, assertion_sig. example header-style JSON for docs:
```
{"trace_id":"abcd1234","service":"edge-proxy","route":"/api/v1/complete","billing_key":"acct_99","assertion_source":"asserted","latency_ms":12,"assertion_sig":"f0a1"}
```

cheng: a few operational points: 1) not all upstreams will have billing_key. we should allow 'derived' values plus a confidence flag; 2) sampling must not break cost reports, so we need deterministic retention for a tiny subset that always carries billing_key.

sam: for missing billing_key let's derive via route->owner map and mark as 'billing_key:derived:<team>' and set assertion_source=derived. reports can filter by assertion_source to separate high-confidence vs derived.

jin: also add a short 12-bit signature/assertion_sig computed from trace_id+billing_key (or route if billing_key missing) so we can spot if proxies strip or mutate headers downstream. cheap to store and compare.

anita: enforcement plan suggestion: phase 0 = log-only + metric obs.assertion_lite.missing{service,route,source}; phase 1 = alert on >3% missing over 10m for public routes; phase 2 = enforced reject (HTTP 422) for critical public endpoints only after 30 days. keep deployment opt-in per infra region first.

mike: i'm +1. two implementation options for older services: 1) sidecar/nginx fast-path that injects headers at TLS termination; 2) SDK helpers for modern services. prefer sidecar to avoid touching lots of code.

cheng: metric cardinality warning: keep labels limited to service,route,assertion_source. do not emit free-form strings as labels. use counters + rate gauges only.

sam: alerting mechanics: tie alert to route-level owners via existing oncall mapping; automatic ticketing when missing spike occurs. include runbook steps to check sidecar config and route->team map.

observability-bot: canary report: svc-edge-canary-2 showed 7.8% missing assertion_lite over last 12m. details: https://go/reports/obs-lite-canary

anita: ack. i'll open the short RFC (schema + headers + rollout timeline) and ping infra to schedule sidecar work.

mike: action items:
- anita: RFC + header names + example nginx snippet (today)
- sam: sidecar prototype + perf microbench (this sprint)
- cheng: add metric names + alert rules to observability repo (this sprint)
- jin: compute assertion_sig helper + unit tests (this sprint)

anita: small note: use header names prefixed `X-RD-`? i prefer `X-RW-` since infra libs already look for that. pick one and be consistent.

mike: go with X-RW- for now: X-RW-Trace-Id, X-RW-Billing-Key, X-RW-Assertion-Source, X-RW-Assertion-Sig, X-RW-Route. keep header set tiny.

anita: ok will include that. thanks everyone. will post RFC link once drafted. :rocket:
